# Checkpoint — Wojciech Reguła, dimension: 可核验时间线

## 身份确认 (documented)
- 博客 wojciechregula.blog "Securing" (© 2017-2026), About-me 页: Principal Security Consultant @ SecuRing (securing.biz); GitHub org "securing"; Twitter @_r3ggi; LinkedIn wojciech-regula
- iOS Security Suite (iOSSecuritySuite) 作者, README 署名 "by @_r3ggi", repo github.com/securing/iOSSecuritySuite, 266 commits
- 排除歧义: 不是 theevilbit (Lazarus/Cedric Owens) 也不是 ChiChou。x.com/_r3ggi 与 person_json.social 一致。

## 已确认事件 (WebFetch 抓取)
- 2018-03-19 起 FreePlane XXE (page 4); 2018-04-26 DASAN routers; 2018-06-02 encrypted photos macOS cache; 2018-07-09 AppSec EU reflection post; 2018-08-21 TouchID bypass; 2018-11-12 Signal leak; 2018-12-18 pasteboard; 2019-01 Logitech, 2019-03 Bear notes, 2019-08 iExplorer Get-Task-Allow, 2019-12 Electron bypass; 2020-03/04/06 XPC exploitation 三部曲; 2020-04-30 iOS 0day SMS; 2020-10 Keychain; 2020-11 Network Extension; 2021-01 physical book lib; 2021-03 rob firefox; 2021-05 CVE-2021-30655 press 5 keys; 2021-06 CVE-2021-30658 M1 GateKeeper; 2021-09-02 CVE-2020-29621 coreaudiod TCC; 2021-09-09 CVE-2020-27937; 2021-12 CVE-2020-10008; 2022 red teaming series; 2022-11 sandbox escape via Terminal; 2023-03 iCloud TCC; 2023-07 Atlassian RCE; 2024-01 Electronizing; 2024-06 SQLite env TCC; 2024-10 launch services TCC; 2026-07 Golden Gate app support.
- CVE-2020-29621 article (2021-09-02): report 2020-06-05 → Apple validated 06-09 → "vast changes" 09-04 → bounty eligible 10-17 → fixed macOS Big Sur 11.1 (2020-12-14). Black Hat USA talk title = "20+ ways to bypass macOS your privacy mechanisms" (note exact wording per article).

## Black Hat
- Black Hat 官网 blackhat.com 对 WebFetch 返回 403。无法直接抓取 briefing 页面 → 标 lead_only/inferred; 演讲事实由本人 blog (primary) 描述。
- About-me 页: "He has presented at Black Hat (Las Vegas), Objective by the Sea (Hawaii), AppSec Global (Tel Aviv), AppSec EU (London), CONFidence (Cracow), BSides (Warsaw)." (documented primary)

## Gap
- 教育/入职 SecuRing 时间无资料 (About-me 未述)。
- iOS Security Suite 首次发布日期 (README 无; commits 计数 266 但无日期) → gap。
- Black Hat 具体年份无法从 primary 确认 (blog 引用 "20+ ways" 未给年份)；记忆/二手不采信。
- 2017 年的早期博客文章 (page 5 返回 404, 实际 site 可能只有 4 页 archive) → earliest documented post = 2018-03-19。
